states: Private mock stack built from this branch (stacked on PR 2600 head 9492f6bbb1). Injected producer-shaped held threshold alerts through the /ws activeAlerts frames and /api/alerts/active: a node temperature alert on West Production B (pve2, latched 76°C under an 80°C trigger) and a guest memory alert on checkout-web-01 (latched 86% under 90%), both last observed two minutes before load. The Mail Gateway alert is synthetic (a host CPU threshold alert on mail-gateway-eu's canonical id agent:pmg-main), because no mock producer raises a threshold alert the gateway row matches

Proxmox node drawer, guest drawer and the nodes table temperature hover at load: 'Temperature 76°C now, back under the 80°C alert level' and 'Memory 86% now, back under the 90% alert level'; the Mail Gateway drawer: 'CPU 72% now, back under the 90% alert level' beside the real message-age alert, which is unchanged

Websocket held and every API read left pending (no data change, one websocket connection, a data-free pong before each step), page clock stepped a minute at a time: at +7 minutes still 'now'; at +9 minutes every surface reads 'Last reading: Temperature 76°C, 11 mins ago' / 'Last reading: Memory 86%, 11 mins ago' / 'Last reading: CPU 72%, 11 mins ago' and the hover reads 'Last reading: Temperature 76°C, 11 mins ago. Stays open until ...'; at +12 minutes all read '14 mins ago'

Same-session control with the six runtime files swapped to the PR 2600 head versions under the same Vite: every surface still said '76°C now, back under the 80°C alert level' (and '86% now', '72% now') fourteen minutes after the last reading
390px phone: both drawers show the same flip and ages (the temperature column is hidden at that width); attention rows wrap without clipping
Last breach line ('Last reading at or above 80°C: 82°C') shows no age in the UI because websocket alert frames carry no lastSeen; unchanged by this change

Attention-copy clock read limited to alerts with a live status: on /proxmox/mail with only the gateway's own message-age alert, the drawer row kept the same DOM node (tagged before the hold) through twelve minutes of clock ticks; with the clock read made unconditional (same session, same Vite) the row was replaced at every recorded step. In a mixed list (message-age plus a threshold alert) every row re-renders on the tick, as each already does on every poll while a resource reports

Re-ran the node drawer, guest drawer, nodes table hover and Mail Gateway drawer flips on the final files at 1440 and 390 wide: 'now' at +7 minutes, 'Last reading: ..., 11 mins ago' at +9, '14 mins ago' at +12, one websocket connection each
interactions: Expanded West Production B on /proxmox and clicked checkout-web-01's guest row, keeping both drawers open across the hold
Held /ws and API reads, then stepped page.clock.runFor one minute at a time for twelve minutes, reading drawer rows and the temperature gauge title at +7, +9 and +12 minutes
Repeated the Proxmox scenario at 390x844 and with the pre-fix runtime files as a control
Tagged each Needs attention row before the hold and compared tags at +7, +9 and +12 minutes, with and without the conditional clock read
